key_claims.claim: Meta reported Q1 total revenue of $42.3 billion, up 16% year over year, or 19% on a constant-currency basis.
key_claims.evidence: All comparisons are on a year-over-year basis unless otherwise noted. Q1 total revenue was 42.3 billion dollars, up 16 percent or 19 percent on a constant currency basis. Q1 total expenses were 24.8 billion dollars, up 9 percent, compared to last year. In terms of the specific line items, cost of revenue increased 14 percent, driven primarily by higher infrastructure costs and payments to partners, partially offset by a benefit from the previously announced extension of server useful lives. R&D increased 22 percent, mostly due to higher employee compensation and infrastructure costs. Marketing and sales increased 8 percent, driven mainly by an increase in professional services related to our ongoing platform integrity efforts.
